headline: South African Municipalities Leave Incoming Leaders With R122.5 Billion Eskom Debt
summary: Municipalities owe power utility Eskom R122.5 billion ahead of local elections, threatening to cut off power supply even to residents who pay their bills on time.
why: Eskom is South Africa's state-owned electric utility provider, and municipal payment defaults pose systemic risks to national energy security and public finances.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Widespread municipal debt burdens threaten the operational viability of the national power provider.
